2608.29901.title: INTERVenE: Temporal-Abstraction-Interval Based Transformers for Short-Horizon Medical Event Prediction
2608.29901.paper_summary: Electronic Health Record (EHR) prediction models in the intensive care unit must learn from sparse and irregular measurements while preserving the clinical meaning of time and supporting transparent decision-making. We present INTERVenE, a family of Transformer architectures whose input is an interval-based, knowledge-based temporal abstraction (KBTA), a token stream of named clinical concepts (states, trends, events, contexts) drawn from a curated medical ontology, rather than an unnamed bin index or a raw measurement triplet. This naming layer is what we ask KBTA to do: it makes the model's per-token attributions resolve to clinical concepts by construction. INTERVenE offers two complementary variants: an auto-regressive decoder that generates future abstraction trajectories with a per-step risk readout (localizing \emph{when} and \emph{after which events} risk rises), and a bidirectional encoder for single-pass joint risk and time-to-event prediction. Evaluated on 57,078 MIMIC-IV admissions against GRU-D, STraTS, and KarmaLego, INTERVenE-Enc reaches a support-weighted AUPRC$_w$ of 0.672, improving by 0.041 over the strongest neural baseline with non-overlapping 95\% bootstrap CIs, while also taking the best AUROC$_w$ (0.901) and length-of-stay MAE (44.4\,h). INTERVenE-Ar (AUROC$_w$ $0.854$, AUPRC$_w$ $0.587$ under the same evaluation contract - a strictly harder generative readout) provides a complementary token-level risk trajectory. An input-representation ablation confirms the lift transfers across structured discretizations, positioning KBTA-based intervals as the interpretable substrate that makes per-token attributions resolve to meaningful clinical concepts within the deployed model.
2608.29901.paper_summary_zh: 電子健康紀錄（EHR）預測模型在重症監護病房必須從稀疏和不規則的測量中學習，同時保持時間的臨床意義並支持透明的決策制定。 我們提出了INTERVenE，一系列Transformer架構，其輸入是一種基於區間的知識基礎時間抽象（KBTA），這是一個來自策劃醫學本體的命名臨床概念（狀態、趨勢、事件、背景）的標記流，而不是未命名的箱索引或原始測量三元組。 這一命名層就是我們要求KBTA做的：它使模型的每個標記的歸因通過構造解析為臨床概念。 INTERVenE提供兩個互補的變體：一個自回歸解碼器，生成未來的抽象軌跡並提供每步的風險讀出（定位\emph{何時}和\emph{在什麼事件之後}風險上升），以及一個雙向編碼器，用於單次通過的聯合風險和事件時間預測。 在57,078個MIMIC-IV入院病例中，INTERVenE-Enc與GRU-D、STraTS和KarmaLego進行評估，達到支持加權的AUPRC$_w$為0.672，較最強的神經基線提高了0.041，且具有不重疊的95\%自助法置信區間，同時也獲得了最佳的AUROC$_w$（0.901）和住院時長MAE（44.4小時）。 INTERVenE-Ar（在相同評估合同下的AUROC$_w$ $0.854$，AUPRC$_w$ $0.587$ - 一個嚴格更難的生成讀出）提供了互補的標記級風險軌跡。 輸入表示的消融實驗確認了提升在結構化離散化之間的轉移，將基於KBTA的區間定位為可解釋的基底，使每個標記的歸因在部署的模型中解析為有意義的臨床概念。
